Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to brown velvety spots on leaves, fruit lesions with corky brown scabs, premature leaf drop.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply fungicides like captan, myclobutanil, or copper-based sprays during early spring. Rake and destroy fallen infected leaves.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Prune trees to improve air circulation, plant disease-resistant apple cultivars, avoid overhead watering.

Apple___Black_rot.symptoms: Frogeye leaf spots with purple borders, rotting fruit with concentric black rings, bark cankers on branches.
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Prune out diseased wood and mummified fruit during winter. Apply captan or thiophanate-methyl fungicides from pink blossom stage.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Remove dead wood and mummified fruit from orchard, maintain tree vigor with balanced fertilizer.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright orange-yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces, tiny tube-like fungal projections on leaf undersides.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Apply myclobutanil or propiconazole fungicide in early spring at first bud break through petal fall.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Remove nearby eastern red cedar trees if feasible, choose resistant apple varieties like Enterprise or Liberty.

Apple___healthy.symptoms: Foliage is lush green, leaves are uniform and free of lesions or discoloration.
Apple___healthy.treatment: No treatment required! Plant is healthy and flourishing.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular watering, seasonal organic mulch, and routine inspection for early pest signs.

Blueberry___healthy.symptoms: Deep green vibrant leaves, strong new shoot growth, no wilting or spotting.
Blueberry___healthy.treatment: No treatment required! Plant is healthy.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure acidic soil pH (4.5–5.5), regular drip irrigation, and annual pine bark mulching.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery fungal coating on leaves and young shoots, leaf curling and distorted terminal growth.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Apply horticultural sulfur spray, potassium bicarbonate, or neem oil at first sign of white powder.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Ensure good sunlight penetration through canopy pruning, avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.symptoms: Leaves are smooth, vibrant green, and free from fungal dust or bacterial shot holes.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Cherry foliage is in optimal condition.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Prune annually during dry weather and protect against bird damage.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.symptoms: Rectangular, brown to gray lesions running parallel to leaf veins, premature leaf death and stalk lodging.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides at VT-R1 growth stage if weather is warm and humid.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Crop rotation with non-host crops (soybean), plant resistant corn hybrids, till residue under.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Golden brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Fungicide applications (pyraclostrobin or azoxystrobin) if pustules appear before tassel emergence.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant rust-resistant corn hybrids, practice early planting.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, elliptical cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions on foliage.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Fungicide sprays (strobilurin + triazole blends) applied at early disease onset.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Rotate crops with non-grasses, select resistant hybrids, manage crop residue.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.symptoms: Broad, vibrant green leaves with strong stalks and healthy tassel/silk development.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Maize crop is flourishing.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Maintain soil moisture during pollination and apply balanced nitrogen.

Grape___Black_rot.symptoms: Reddish-brown leaf spots with black fruiting specks, berries shrivel into hard black mummies.
Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Apply myclobutanil, mancozeb, or captan from pre-bloom through 4 weeks post-bloom.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Remove mummified berries from vines and ground, maintain open canopy for sun exposure.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).symptoms: Tiger-stripe patterns (yellow and brown necrosis) between leaf veins, dark spots on berries.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Prune out diseased cordon or trunk. Treat pruning wounds with fungicide paste or biocontrol agent.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Avoid pruning during wet periods, sanitize pruning shears between vines.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.symptoms: Irregular dark brown patches on leaf margins, dark fuzzy spores on underside in humid conditions.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Copper-based fungicides or Bordeaux mixture sprays during late spring.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Ensure good vineyard airflow, clear leaf debris from vineyard floor.

Grape___healthy.symptoms: Lush emerald foliage, clean grape clusters, robust vine growth.
Grape___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Grapevine is healthy.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Annual pruning, canopy management, and balanced potassium nutrition.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).symptoms: Asymmetrical blotchy yellow leaf mottling, yellow shoots, small lopsided bitter green fruit.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: Control the insect vector (Asian citrus psyllid) using systemic insecticides. Remove severely infected trees.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Plant certified disease-free nursery stock, use psyllid traps and biocontrol wasps.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Water-soaked polygonal leaf spots turning purple-black and dropping out (shot-hole appearance), pitted fruit.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply oxytetracycline or copper sprays at low rates during dormant season and early petal fall.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant resistant peach cultivars, avoid planting in extremely sandy soil, windbreaks.

Peach___healthy.symptoms: Clean, spear-shaped bright green leaves, smooth bark, healthy branch development.
Peach___healthy.treatment: No treatment required! Tree is in prime health.
Peach___healthy.prevention: Annual pruning, dormant copper spray to prevent peach leaf curl.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, water-soaked dark brown circular spots on leaves and stems, leaf yellowing and defoliation.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper bactericide mixed with mancozeb weekly during wet spells.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed, avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation, rotate crops.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.symptoms: Glossy deep green foliage, erect bushy growth, healthy flower buds and fruit set.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Pepper plant is thriving.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Maintain steady moisture, organic mulch, and calcium-rich fertilizer.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric dark brown rings forming target-like patterns on older lower leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Spray chlorothalonil, azoxystrobin, or copper hydroxide fungicide at first sign of target spots.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Maintain plant vigor with nitrogen, avoid overhead watering, rotate crops every 3 years.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large, irregular dark water-soaked lesions on leaves with white fuzzy fungal growth underneath in damp weather.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Immediately apply systemic fungicides like mandipropamid, fluopicolide, or chlorothalonil. Remove severely infected foliage.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified seed tubers, destroy volunteer potatoes, ensure good hill drainage.

Potato___healthy.symptoms: Robust green foliage with crisp leaflets, vigorous vegetative growth.
Potato___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Potato foliage is healthy.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Hill soil around potato stems, mulch to preserve soil moisture.

Raspberry___healthy.symptoms: Healthy serrated composite leaves with pale green undersides, sturdy canes.
Raspberry___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Raspberry canes are in top condition.
Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Prune out old floricanes after fruiting, provide trellis support.

Soybean___healthy.symptoms: Trifoliate leaves with vibrant green coloration and uniform leaflet structure.
Soybean___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Soybean crop is healthy.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Practice crop rotation, maintain soil phosphorus and potassium levels.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.symptoms: Powdery talcum-like white spots spreading over upper and lower leaf surfaces, leaves turn yellow and wither.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Spray neem oil, potassium bicarbonate, or sulfur fungicide at first appearance of white spots.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant powdery mildew-resistant squash varieties, space plants widely for maximum sunlight.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.symptoms: Numerous small, irregular purplish spots that enlarge and merge, giving leaves a scorched, burnt appearance.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Apply captan, myclobutanil, or copper fungicides after harvest and in early spring.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Mow and remove old strawberry leaves after harvest, improve bed aeration.

Strawberry___healthy.symptoms: Lush trifoliate leaves, healthy white blossoms, no spots or scorching.
Strawberry___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Strawberry bed is healthy.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Straw mulching under fruit, regular drip irrigation, runner management.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark greasy spots on leaves surrounded by yellow halos, scab-like spots on green tomatoes.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Spray copper bactericide combined with mancozeb. Remove infected lower leaves.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds, avoid working in garden when plants are wet, rotate solanaceous crops.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric rings forming target spots on older lower leaves, leaves yellow around spots and drop.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply copper fungicide, chlorothalonil, or mancozeb. Prune bottom 12 inches of leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Mulch soil surface to prevent soil splash onto lower leaves, stake and cage tomatoes.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Large dark brown water-soaked blotches on leaves and stems, white mold on underside in wet weather, fruit rot.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply systemic fungicides (e.g., cymoxanil, mandipropamid) immediately upon alert. Pull and destroy heavily infected plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead watering, allow ample spacing, destroy volunteer potato/tomato plants.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale greenish-yellow spots on leaf upper surface, velvety olive-green mold on leaf underside.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Apply copper spray or chlorothalonil. Improve greenhouse ventilation and reduce humidity below 85%.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Prune foliage to increase air movement, maintain dry leaf surfaces.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Numerous circular spots with dark brown margins and gray centers containing tiny black specks.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or copper fungicide weekly. Prune off diseased lower foliage.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotate crops, mulch heavily around tomato base, never water from above.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.symptoms: Fine yellow stippling on leaf upper side, fine silk webbing under leaves, leaf bronzing and drying.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Spray insecticidal soap, neem oil, or horticultural oil thoroughly on leaf undersides. Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis).
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Maintain soil humidity in hot weather, wash dusty leaves with water spray.

Tomato___Target_Spot.symptoms: Small brown circular spots with pale centers on leaves, lesions on fruit with dark brown depressed margins.
Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Apply strobilurin or carboxamide fungicides. Remove infected plant debris.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Ensure good airflow, avoid overhead watering, rotate crops.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.symptoms: Severe upward leaf curling, yellow leaf margins, stunting of plant, flower drop, and poor fruit yield.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: No cure once infected. Control whitefly insect vectors using yellow sticky traps, insecticidal soaps, or imidacloprid.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use TYLCV-resistant tomato varieties, install fine mesh insect screens in greenhouses.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled light and dark green mosaic patterns on leaves, leaf distortion (shoestring effect), internal browning in fruit.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: No chemical cure. Remove and discard infected plants immediately. Disinfect tools in 10% bleach.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Wash hands with soap before handling plants (especially smokers), plant resistant varieties.

Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Deep emerald foliage, strong stems, vibrant yellow flowers, clean skin on developing fruit.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: No treatment needed! Tomato plant is in excellent health.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Stake plants, prune suckers for airflow, provide consistent watering.
